title: MZ Missing Profile from NWJS Error

posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body:
I received this message recently and thought it would just go away.
"Your profile can not be used because it is from a newer version of NW.js.
Some features may be unavailable. Please specify a different profile directory or use a newer version of NW.js."
These are the things that I've tried so far.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/554600/discussions/0/2521353993650792038/
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...-playtest-game-play-nw-js.103824/#post-928703
https://stackoverflow.com/questions...d-because-it-is-from-a-newer-version-of-nw-js
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...s just an NWJS,game from your download folder
.
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...urred-during-playtest-game-play-nw-js.103824/
The issue shows on RPG Maker MZ, but not MV.
I had no web data or web data-journal folder at %AppData%\Local\nwjs when I had checked it. I have a copy of NWJS, but I don't have the instructions how to manually replace the data. I assumed it would show up after compiling my project, but nothing showed up.
I am using RPG Maker MZ (1.9.1) from Steam on Windows 10.
I thought the issue might be project specific, but it shows on all projects.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
I get that as well for MV.
when you run your NWJS (project / game of equal nwjs) it wont
show up, once you play a game with a lower nwjs, it and than one
with newer, it pops up again.
you can safely ignore that issue as I don't know how to get rid of
it permanently as well, can be annoying, but is totally harmless.
